description: remove aria-hidden=true from the Scissors icon
reason: lucide-react 0.561 adds aria-hidden="true" to the svg by default when no aria-label/title/children are passed (checked with renderToStaticMarkup: <svg ... class="lucide lucide-scissors size-3" aria-hidden="true">). Removing the prop leaves the rendered DOM identical, so no DOM test can tell them apart. See m160b for the observable variant.
